document.abstract: This document outlines the architecture and structure of changes to the existing broadly used MPEG-2 transport stream specification to accommodate efficient transmission of uncompressed video over MPEG-2 transport stream. It details how uncompressed video is packed into an elementary stream and PES stream. It outlines an encapsulation structure for carrying uncompressed video over transport streams and relies on existing SMPTE ST 302, SMPTE ST 2038, ITU-T Recommendation H.222.0 / ISO/IEC 13818-1 for PAT, PMT and PID management structures.
